newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star Technologies sees $12.45 mln gain.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star Technologies sees $12.45 mln gain.

text.p: Lone Star Technologies Inc said Monday it will post a $12.45 million gain in the third quarter related to its sale of American Federal Bank.
The company said it agreed with Guaranty Federal Bank to distribute the remainder of the $15 million that is in an escrow account established in connection with the sale.
Lone Star said the sale price for American Federal Bank was $155.7 million, of which it received $135.7 million on the sale date in 1993 and $5 million in 1994.
The remaining $15 million had been retained in escrow to pay claims that may be made by Guaranty.
Lone Star said it has recognized the funds it has received as income in the period that it has received them.

In addition to the final settlement of the escrow account, Lone Star on July 29 called for the redemption of the entire $50 million of its eight percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2002 at the redemption price of 100 percent of the principal amount.
The debentures can be converted into Lone Star common stock at a conversion price of $24.25 per share. Lone Star common is currently trading at 32-9/16, up one.
